description: Pennsylvania motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: A Pennsylvania motorcycle learner's permit holder may ride
options: Only between sunrise and sunset, with no passengers
At any hour, as long as a licensed rider follows
With one passenger who is 18 or older, in daylight
Only on limited-access highways, with no passengers
questions.explanation: The Class M learner's permit allows riding only between sunrise and sunset, and no passengers except a properly licensed instructor.

questions.q: Before a Pennsylvania rider under 18 can get a motorcycle license, they must
options: Complete the PA Motorcycle Safety Program Basic Rider Course
Hold the motorcycle learner permit for at least two full years
Pass the commercial driver general knowledge test
Wait until age 17 and then pass the regular riding skills test
questions.explanation: PennDOT requires anyone under 18 to complete the Pennsylvania Motorcycle Safety Program Basic Rider Course before a motorcycle license is issued.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Pennsylvania?
What does Pennsylvania law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
questions.explanation: Pennsylvania: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Pennsylvania require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Pennsylvania: eye protection is required for all riders.
